OVHcloud / Gridscale.summary_note: OVHcloud is France's most advanced sovereign cloud provider and holds the strongest EU certification portfolio of any provider in this survey, including SecNumCloud 3.2 qualification (ANSSI) for Private Cloud and Bare Metal Pod granted March 2025. Its unique advantage is in-house server manufacturing at Croix, France — no other EU cloud provider designs and assembles its own hardware at this scale, which significantly improves SOV-5 supply chain scores. The most critical sovereignty weakness is the September 2024 Ontario Court of Justice ruling, which provides documented judicial confirmation that a non-EU authority (Canada) successfully compelled access to OVHcloud data stored in France via its Canadian subsidiary — a real-world precedent that directly undermines SOV-2-Q3. The US subsidiary (OVHcloud US) further creates CLOUD Act group-level residual exposure. For customers requiring the highest sovereignty level, OVHcloud's SecNumCloud-qualified tier addresses most weaknesses. Standard products carry meaningful jurisdictional risks due to the multi-national corporate structure.
